summary: Contribution by Kristian Muri Knausgård. Derived from Josu San Martin's critical-line-669-800 (2026-11-21, Apache-2.0), which combines the Zeta23 distinct-zero theorem of Alpöge and Furman with the leaderboard's accepted RH foundation; its numerical enclosure is from typh's five-point-pyramid and Samuel Lavery's attempt-002. The only change is the rational floor: the record's lemma gam_upper already proves x cot x <= 0.8274993018 at x = sqrt(2)/2, which gives 5/4 - 0.8274993018/2 = 0.8362503491 instead of 0.83625. No new mathematics.
method: Published RH foundation and Montgomery–Taylor distinct-zero estimate, rational floor at the strength of the record's own enclosure
